function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the caller's identity using the last 4 digits of PAN or birth year BEFORE any debt details may be revealed. Must be called before any debt-related disclosure and its result is the only thing allowed to unlock disclosure.

account_id.description: The customer's account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN suffix or 4-digit birth year provided by the caller.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Records the customer's agreed payment date and amount. Only call this after identity has been verified and the customer has given a specific date and amount.

ptp_date.description: ISO-8601 date (e.g. 2026-08-14) or a clearly resolvable descriptive date agreed upon.

amount.description: The amount in INR the customer agreed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered number. Only call after log_promise_to_pay has succeeded.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Routes the case to a human agent for disputes, hardship claims, or anything the bot cannot safely resolve on its own. The bot must never negotiate waivers or discounts itself.

notes.description: Brief summary of the customer's situation for the human agent.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call. Must be called exactly once before the call ends.

notes.description: Optional short free-text context for the disposition.
